title: Variance assessment (is the difference real?)
description: Stage contract recording whether an observed difference between conditions is real, and under which of four verdicts. UNDERPOWERED is deliberately its own value and must NEVER be collapsed into NO_DETECTABLE_DIFFERENCE: 'cannot measure it' is not 'there is no difference', and conflating the two justifies a wrong product decision -- the most expensive mistake in grease R&D. A NO_DETECTABLE_DIFFERENCE verdict asserts only that the design could have detected the pre-registered effect and did not; REPLICATE_INCONSISTENT blocks any difference claim until the replicate structure is repaired. Every statistic here is produced by the deterministic engine and only reported through this artifact: computed_by is const ENGINE, because this pack forbids hand-entered numbers for computed statistics (the LLM must not do deterministic computation).

iteration.description: Inner-loop campaign iteration this variance assessment belongs to. Strictly positive.

replicate_structure.description: How the observations are nested, one entry per level (MEASUREMENT / BENCH / BATCH). The structure decides which sigma components are estimable at all.

censoring.description: One entry per observation that is not a clean end-point. May be empty only when every observation is uncensored; stop_reason is hard-required on every entry so an administrative stop can never masquerade as a completed observation.

intervention_events.description: Non-protocol events that occurred during the campaign and could confound the comparison. May be empty. An entry with confounds true weakens any difference claim.

effect_size.description: Computed effect size. Null when not estimable (for example under heavy censoring).

power.description: Computed power of the design against the pre-registered delta. Null when not estimable. A low value is what makes verdict UNDERPOWERED.

k_ratio.description: Ratio between the sigma this design can tolerate and the sigma actually required; the frozen k of SIGMA_MAX <= delta / k. Null when not computable.

sigma_max_requirement.description: The owner-set requirement threshold the measured sigma_total is compared against. Null when no frozen requirement exists yet.

resolution_table.description: Engine-computed resolution table: what difference this design could detect at the recorded replicate counts. May be empty when the design is not estimable.

verdict.description: CONSISTENT_DIFFERENCE (real difference, replicates agree) / NO_DETECTABLE_DIFFERENCE (properly powered, nothing found) / UNDERPOWERED (design cannot resolve the question -- never a synonym for no difference) / REPLICATE_INCONSISTENT (replicates contradict, structure must be repaired).

computed_by.description: Always ENGINE: this pack forbids hand-entered numbers for computed statistics (the LLM must not do deterministic computation; the engine does).

frozen_sigma_reference.description: Optional reference to the frozen sigma/SIGMA_MAX record the comparison used.

preregistered_delta.description: Optional difference pre-registered before the runs, against which power was computed. Null when none was registered.

event_time.description: Event time when the event occurred; null for a censored observation. A censoring time is never recorded as an event time.

stop_reason.description: Why the observation stopped. Hard-required on every censoring entry (never optional, never empty), so no censored value can be presented without its cause.

at.description: When the intervention happened, as recorded by the operator (ISO date-time or a protocol step marker).

confounds.description: Whether this event can confound the comparison under assessment.

components.description: Variance components, engine-computed, each number-or-null. The optional confidence interval for a component uses the flat <component>_ci_low / <component>_ci_high shape consistently for all four components (there is no nested ci object).
